title: Defective Parts Return Process
text:
### Purpose

Dealer returns a defective part to the regional distribution centre.

| Step | Actor | System | Notes |
| Raise return request | Dealer parts manager | Dealer portal | Free-text defect description |
| Review and authorise | Claims clerk | SAP ECC and email | Re-keyed manually into ECC |
| Ship the part | Dealer parts manager | Carrier portal | No visibility in SAP |
| Goods receipt | DC operator | Warehouse management | Delivery tolerance checked before posting |
| Technical inspection | Technical inspector | Inspection spreadsheet | Outcome recorded outside SAP |
| Credit or rejection | Aftersales finance | SAP ECC | Weekly reconciliation |

#### Known issues

- Double keying between the portal and ECC
- Inspection evidence is not auditable
- Dealers cannot see status between shipping and credit

#### Custom objects

- ZRET_AUTH custom return authorisation table
- ZRET_REPORT reconciliation report
